description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function 'smarty_literal_compiler_param' which evaluates a compiler parameter to ensure it is a literal, providing compile-time safety checks and evaluation.

methods.name: smarty_literal_compiler_param
methods.description: Evaluates a compiler parameter to ensure it is a literal value. Checks parameter existence, validates literal using regex, and evaluates it with eval(). Throws SmartyException if not a literal.
